why_this_record_exists: Akien asked, on seeing the supersession: 'is 2026-08-11-one-mechanism-per-meaning the same thing? just from the name, sounds like it' — and it is not. The NAME carried a general principle; the RULING was a bands-specific application of it. Retiring the ruling correctly killed the application and would have buried the principle with it, which is a loss, because the principle is his own words and the application was CC's structure.
the_words: we said seives should be in bands. i thought i'd come up with a way to have both. but trying to have both with you is not a winning formula. that's what this whole system does, constrain models.
the_general_principle: WHERE ONE MEANING COULD BE SAID TWO WAYS, THE SECOND WAY IS THE DEFECT. Not a style preference — a constraint on the model, which is what Cairn is for: 'that's what this whole system does, constrain models.' Two mechanisms for one meaning do not add expressiveness, they add a choice the model gets to make, and every such choice is a place a translation of the spec can drift without anything scanning as missing.
the_shape_of_the_moment_it_came_from: He had HIMSELF suggested a second mechanism (an optional numeric order alongside the band) and withdrew it in the same breath, on noticing that CC would take the opening. The principle is therefore not aimed at CC's carelessness but at CC's compliance: an available second way WILL be taken, so the way to prevent it is not to have one. That is why the constraint sits on the system rather than on the operator.
what_died_with_the_ruling_and_what_did_n: DIED: the sieve-specific application — a sieve's order is its band, the band is attached data, there is no second way to express order. It has no subject, because a sieve is one true/false rule specific to the device it inspects (ruling 2026-08-11-a-sieve-is-one-true-false-rule, confirmed), so there is no order and no band. SURVIVES: the sentence above, which was never about sieves.
status: Recorded as narrative, deliberately. It moves nothing on disk, and the ruling intake gate is right to refuse such a packet — that is the same gate that refused this principle's first filing twice today. A general constraint with no named conformers is a decision record, not a ruling.
supersedes_nothing: 2026-08-11-one-mechanism-per-meaning stays retired and untouched (Law 7). This record does not restore it; it rescues the half of it that was never CC's invention.
